findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: poolbrain_list_users, poolbrain_create_customer, poolbrain_create_customer_note · Private data: poolbrain_list_companies, poolbrain_search_customers, poolbrain_create_customer, poolbrain_update_customer, poolbrain_create_customer_note · Public sink: poolbrain_list_users, poolbrain_create_customer, poolbrain_create_customer_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: poolbrain_list_users, poolbrain_create_customer, poolbrain_create_customer_note · Private data: poolbrain_list_companies, poolbrain_search_customers, poolbrain_create_customer, poolbrain_update_customer, poolbrain_create_customer_note · Public sink: poolbrain_list_users, poolbrain_create_customer, poolbrain_create_customer_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
